import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os

before_path = "Before_2025"
after_path = "After_2025"
transformer_ids = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8"]


# ----------------------------------------------------
# SHARED LOADER FUNCTION (used by both analyses)
# ----------------------------------------------------
def load_transformer_data(trans_id):
    suffix_before = f"{trans_id}-20230101-20241231.csv" if trans_id != "3" else f"{trans_id} -20230101-20241231.csv"
    suffix_after  = f"{trans_id}-20250101-20250605.csv" if trans_id != "3" else f"{trans_id} -20250101-20250605.csv"

    before_file = os.path.join(before_path, f"E-Trans {suffix_before}")
    after_file  = os.path.join(after_path,  f"E-Trans {suffix_after}")

    df_before = pd.read_csv(before_file)
    df_after  = pd.read_csv(after_file)

    df = pd.concat([df_before, df_after], ignore_index=True)

    df["EntryDT"] = pd.to_datetime(df["EntryDT"], errors="coerce")
    df = df.dropna(subset=["EntryDT", "ActivePowerP1", "ActivePowerP2", "ActivePowerP3"])
    
    df["TotalActivePower_kW"] = (
        df["ActivePowerP1"] + df["ActivePowerP2"] + df["ActivePowerP3"]
    )

    return df

# ----------------------------------------------------
# ANALYSIS 1 — Boxplots
# ----------------------------------------------------
def plot_boxplots():
    power_distributions = {}

    for trans_id in transformer_ids:
        try:
            df = load_transformer_data(trans_id)
            power_distributions[f"T{trans_id}"] = df["TotalActivePower_kW"]
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error loading T{trans_id}: {e}")

    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
    plt.boxplot(
        power_distributions.values(),
        labels=power_distributions.keys(),
        showfliers=False
    )
    plt.xticks(rotation=45)
    plt.ylabel("Total Active Power (kW)")
    plt.title("Boxplot of Total Active Power per Transformer")
    plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
plot_boxplots()

# ----------------------------------------------------
# ANALYSIS 2 — Village-wide hourly curve
# ----------------------------------------------------
def plot_hourly_village_curve():
    all_e_trans = []

    for trans_id in transformer_ids:
        df = load_transformer_data(trans_id)
        df["Hour"] = df["EntryDT"].dt.hour
        all_e_trans.append(df)

    df_all = pd.concat(all_e_trans, ignore_index=True)
    hourly_avg = df_all.groupby("Hour")["TotalActivePower_kW"].mean().reset_index()

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
    plt.plot(hourly_avg["Hour"], hourly_avg["TotalActivePower_kW"],
             marker='o', label="Village-wide Avg Load")

    plt.title("Village-Wide Hourly Average Load Curve (kW)")
    plt.xlabel("Hour of Day")
    plt.ylabel("Avg Power (kW)")
    plt.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
    plt.legend()
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
plot_hourly_village_curve()

def compute_hourly_profile(df):
    df["HourTimestamp"] = df["EntryDT"].dt.floor("h")
    hourly = df.groupby("HourTimestamp")["TotalActivePower_kW"].sum().reset_index()
    hourly["HourOfDay"] = hourly["HourTimestamp"].dt.hour
    return hourly.groupby("HourOfDay")["TotalActivePower_kW"].mean().reset_index()


def plot_duck_curves():
    hourly_profiles = {}

    for trans_id in transformer_ids:
        df = load_transformer_data(trans_id)
        hourly_profiles[f"Transformer {trans_id}"] = compute_hourly_profile(df)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 3, figsize=(22, 12), constrained_layout=True)
    axes = axes.flatten()

    for i, (name, prof) in enumerate(hourly_profiles.items()):
        ax = axes[i]
        ax.plot(prof["HourOfDay"], prof["TotalActivePower_kW"],
                marker='o', linewidth=2)
        ax.set_title(name)
        ax.set_xticks(range(0, 25, 6))
        ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

    # Remove unused 9th subplot
    fig.delaxes(axes[-1])

    fig.suptitle("Duck Curve – Hourly Power per Transformer", fontsize=16)
    plt.savefig("duck_curve_per_transformer.png", dpi=300)
    plt.show()

plot_duck_curves()

# ===============================================================
#   PARTIE COMMUNE : chargement, nettoyage, pairing
# ===============================================================
import os, re, math
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

before_dir = Path("Before_2025")
after_dir  = Path("After_2025")

# ----- helpers communs -----------------------------------------------------

def list_individual(folder: Path):
    return [p for p in folder.iterdir()
            if p.name.startswith("M-") and p.suffix.lower() == ".csv"]

def root_name(fname: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"-\d{6,8}.*\.csv$", "", fname)

def clean(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.dropna(axis=1, how="all")
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    return df

def find_entrydt(df: pd.DataFrame) -> str | None:
    for c in df.columns:
        if c.replace(" ", "").lower().startswith("entrydt"):
            return c
    return None

P_COLS = ["ActivePowerP1", "ActivePowerP2", "ActivePowerP3"]

# ----- construction des paires before/after -------------------------------

pairs = {}
for f in list_individual(before_dir):
    pairs.setdefault(root_name(f.name), {})["before"] = f
for f in list_individual(after_dir):
    pairs.setdefault(root_name(f.name), {})["after"]  = f

# ===============================================================
#   SCRIPT 1 : PROFILS MOYENS FILTRÉS (0.05–0.35 kW)
# ===============================================================

def hourly_profile_filtered(paths: dict) -> pd.Series | None:
    if {"before", "after"} - paths.keys():
        return None
    
    df = pd.concat(
        [clean(pd.read_csv(paths["before"])),
         clean(pd.read_csv(paths["after"]))],
        ignore_index=True, join="inner"
    )

    ts = find_entrydt(df)
    if ts is None or not set(P_COLS).issubset(df.columns):
        return None

    df[ts] = pd.to_datetime(df[ts], errors="coerce")
    df = df.sort_values(ts).dropna(subset=[ts]).drop_duplicates(ts)

    df["Ptot"] = df[P_COLS].sum(axis=1, skipna=True)
    df = df[df["Ptot"] > 0]
    if df.empty:
        return None

    if df["Ptot"].median() > 1000:
        df["Ptot"] /= 1000

    df["Hour"] = df[ts].dt.hour
    hourly_avg = df.groupby("Hour")["Ptot"].mean()

    # filtre
    if (hourly_avg < 0.05).any() or (hourly_avg > 0.35).any():
        return None

    return hourly_avg

# ---- collecte ----
all_profiles = []
for meter, pathdict in pairs.items():
    prof = hourly_profile_filtered(pathdict)
    if prof is not None:
        all_profiles.append(prof)

# ---- plot ----
if all_profiles:
    df_profiles = pd.concat(all_profiles, axis=1)
    df_profiles.columns = [f"Household_{i+1}" for i in range(len(df_profiles.columns))]

    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
    for col in df_profiles.columns:
        plt.plot(df_profiles.index, df_profiles[col], alpha=0.3, linewidth=1)

    median_curve = df_profiles.median(axis=1)
    q1 = df_profiles.quantile(0.25, axis=1)
    q3 = df_profiles.quantile(0.75, axis=1)

    plt.plot(df_profiles.index, median_curve, color="black", linewidth=2, label="Median")
    plt.fill_between(df_profiles.index, q1, q3, color="red", alpha=0.2, label="IQR")

    plt.title("Hourly residential profiles (filtered 0.05–0.35 kW)")
    plt.xlabel("Hour")
    plt.ylabel("Power (kW)")
    plt.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.legend()
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("Aucun profil dans les bornes 0.05–0.35 kW.")

# ===============================================================
#   SCRIPT 2 : DUCK-CURVES PAR COMPTEUR (non filtrées)
# ===============================================================

def hourly_profile_raw(paths: dict) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    if {"before", "after"} - paths.keys():
        return None

    df = pd.concat(
        [clean(pd.read_csv(paths["before"])),
         clean(pd.read_csv(paths["after"]))],
        ignore_index=True, join="inner"
    )

    ts = find_entrydt(df)
    if ts is None:
        return None

    df[ts] = pd.to_datetime(df[ts], errors="coerce")
    df = df.sort_values(ts).dropna(subset=[ts]).drop_duplicates(ts)

    df["Ptot"] = df[P_COLS].sum(axis=1)
    df = df[df["Ptot"] > 0]
    if df.empty:
        return None

    # conversion auto en kW
    if df["Ptot"].median() > 1000:
        df["Ptot"] /= 1000

    df["Hour"] = df[ts].dt.hour
    return df.groupby("Hour")["Ptot"].mean().reset_index()


# ---- collecte ----
profiles = {}
for meter_idx, (meter, pathdict) in enumerate(pairs.items(), start=1):
    prof = hourly_profile_raw(pathdict)
    if prof is not None:
        profiles[f"House profile {meter_idx}"] = prof

print(f"{len(profiles)} compteurs traités.")


# ---- plot ----
if profiles:
    N, COLS = len(profiles), 4
    ROWS = math.ceil(N / COLS)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(ROWS, COLS,
                             figsize=(4 * COLS, 2.8 * ROWS),
                             constrained_layout=True)
    axes = axes.flatten()

    for i, (anon_name, prof) in enumerate(sorted(profiles.items())):
        ax = axes[i]
        ax.plot(prof["Hour"], prof["Ptot"], marker='o', lw=.9)
        ax.set_title(anon_name, fontsize=7)
        ax.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
        ax.grid(alpha=.3)

    # remove unused axes
    for j in range(i + 1, len(axes)):
        fig.delaxes(axes[j])

    plt.show()
else:
    print("Aucun profil généré.")
